I am very pleased with the resulting treatment for a Mouler crown in gold. The major difference in that this practice is extremely attentive to detail and comfort. Plus their Laser scanning system means that the crown is manufactured to better than 0.1mm tolerance. It therefore fits perfectly at installation. That also means it keeps its beautiful shine. No filing required.
The cost for my crown was 25% of UK prices. 15 of gramms of gold is about £1000.GBP, yet my treatment cost only slightly more. Check this for your self, but my search with Laser 3D sculpting costs minimum of £4000 GBP. Free holiday to boot?
Kind regards
Mark Lewis
Reading UK

I to disagree with Denis. This lady is simply the best. Her work is excellent, I have been going here for over 10 years, my wife too. We have had 4 in-plants and 2  crowns and a few fillings. She is the best dentist I have ever seen and I am 70 years old. The prices are fair and they are never rude. Maybe Denis doesn't understand that they are not speaking English as their first language, that maybe why he thought they were rude. If you are reading reviews to pick a dentist then pick this one. Denis go and get your self checked out, you don't know what you are talking about.
Took me on the spot (as time was or the essence). Did all my work needed in 20 minutes, very impressed. So kind and polite. Thank you sincerely.

The smile design dental clinic is one of the most professional dentists in pattaya City as the quality of services provided to me was so much more that I expected and the staff are friendly with very affordable prices.

Wanted to have a root canal. No xray was taken Was given info and price, after exam. went for a second opinion from another dentist. Had xray from other dentist and was told new information.  Went back with xray to schedule the treatment but wanted to ask another  question first only an hour or so later they wanted to charge me again for exam. I said  I was just here, I only want her to see if the xray would change her opinion.Wasn't much, but I  was wanting to have my procedure done there. She kept saying 100 baht repeatedly. It was the principle to me, as 100 baht is nothing. Receptionist was rude. Left politely.
I disagree with Dennis. This place is clean with sterilization ,reasonable prices and good take care from team.
